sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: GM09 v1 requires schemaVersion:1, frame:"component" and a unique native feature ref in the selected component (from feature.list result.features or entity.list {kind:feature}). Legacy payloads without schemaVersion/frame keep the assembly feature contract. Tokens are authoritative over stale names; use native refs for authoritative owned-parameter discovery. Proxy feature identity may not match native createdBy.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, status, documentIdentity, units:{length:cm,angle:rad}, frame:{space:component,component}, associativity:nativeReference, provenance:GM09, feature (ref), name, type, healthState, message, isParametric/isSuppressed/isSolid, timelineIndex (when exposed), parameters:[{role,name,expression,unit,value,target?,ownership?}], extent:{mode,...}, roleSource and limitations. Roles are read from the feature structure, never guessed from a generic label such as AlongDistance; parameters the structure does not expose stay role unknown. Unsupported feature types report extent.mode:"unsupported" and roleSource:"unknown".

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Read-only; no activation/save/recompute. Foreign extent targets are classified with ownership foreign, editable:false and transform:"not evaluated", never a fake associative copy.

examples.label: Inspect an extrude feature (v1)
examples.requires: A selected component whose feature is a native extrude; substitute a real returned ref rather than a stale token.
examples.output: result.parameters lists structural roles/expressions/units; result.extent summarizes the typical extent.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: GM09 v1 requires schemaVersion:1, frame:"component" and a native feature ref; at least one of name, entries [{name?,role?,expression}], extent, operationChange or nativeEdits. entries updates exact owned ModelParameters (known roles include extrude/revolve/hole/sweep; parameter rows cover fillet/chamfer/hole/pattern/shell/thicken; exact names are authoritative). extent supports extrude one-side/symmetric/two-side distance, throughAll and toEntity; revolve angle/symmetric/two-side angle/toEntity; hole distance/throughAll/toEntity. nativeEdits is a feature-specific object: Extrude {profile}; Revolve {profile,axis}; Fillet/Chamfer {edgeSets:[{index,edges?,radius/chordLength/startRadius/endRadius/offsetOne/offsetTwo/midRadii/midPositions/distance/distanceOne/distanceTwo/angle/tangentChain/continuity/tangencyWeight/isFlipped}]}; Hole {holeType:{type:simple|counterbore|countersink,...},position:{mode:sketchPoint|sketchPoints|center|offsets|onEdge,...},participants}; circular/rectangular/path Pattern {entities,axis/directionOneEntity/directionTwoEntity,path,isSymmetric*,suppressedElementsIds,patternDistanceType,startPoint,isFlipDirection}; Mirror {entities,mirrorPlane,patternComputeOption}; Shell {entities,insideThickness,outsideThickness,isTangentChain,shellType}; Sweep {profile,path,orientation,guideRail,guideSurfaces,isDirectionFlipped,isChainSelection,participants}; Loft {sections,rails,centerLine,sectionConditions,isClosed,isTangentEdgesMerged,startLoftEdgeAlignment,endLoftEdgeAlignment,participants}; Thicken {entities,isSymmetric,thickenType,isChainSelection}. nativeEdits needs confirm:true when applied, is mutually exclusive with name/entries/extent/operationChange, and refuses unsafe type conversion/cardinality changes. Transient Point3D hole positioning and solidBody sweep conversion are refused; use associative references. See catalog/manual schemas for exact enums and nested shapes. Preview is read-only. Legacy payloads without schemaVersion retain the assembly contract.

sections.title: Operation Change
sections.text: operationChange is supported for ExtrudeFeature, RevolveFeature, SweepFeature, LoftFeature and ThickenFeature only when the SDK exposes settable operation and participantBodies. Extrude operations are newBody/join/cut; other supported types also accept intersect when exposed. newBody forbids participants; join/cut/intersect require explicit owned native body refs. expected must equal current operation; expected==value is a verified no-op, changing a non-Extrude operation requires confirm:true. Requires timeline marker at end; reports directSolidBodyCount, health, marker and pose readback. Other feature families explicitly reject/defer operation changes.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has schemaVersion:1, status, before/after snapshots, feature type, exact parameters, health, timeline marker positions, resolved identity/reference lineage, skipped/unsupported fields and restore diagnostics. operationChange adds actualOperation/directSolidBodyCount/identity/health/marker/poses. nativeEdits adds before/after native property readback and confirmed mutation diagnostics. Preview returns applied:false, mutation:false and the proposed edit plan.

sections.title: Safety And Workflow
sections.text: Non-atomic; failures never delete or rebuild features. Parameter edits update owned ModelParameters in place. Reference edits require confirm:true, preflight scope/type/cardinality before first setter, roll history immediately before documented SDK setters and restore the captured marker in finally. Loft section/rail cardinality is preserved; feature-type conversion is refused. Offline tests verify routing/contracts only; native SDK/kernel acceptance remains pending same-author leased tests. Partial effects are reported; never auto-undo/replay. Run feature.inspect before and history.check after.

examples.label: Edit an extrude parameter and extent (v1)
examples.requires: A native extrude feature in the selected component whose structure exposes the startOffset/distance roles (confirm with feature.inspect).
examples.output: result.applied is true; result.conflicts is empty when readback matches the requested expressions.

examples.label: Change an extrude operation to join
examples.requires: The current operation is newBody (confirm with feature.inspect); the timeline marker is at the end; body-token is a native body owned by the selected component. expected==value is a verified no-op; expected!=value applies the native setter.
examples.output: result.operationChange.actualOperation is join, directSolidBodyCount equals expectedResultBodyCount, and markerRestored/posesPreserved are true.
